description: This file is a C header file providing function declarations, macro definitions, and includes related to utility functions for the 'bbf.config' daemon, such as service reloading, UCI configuration management, and communication with ubus.

methods.name: strncpyt
methods.description: Copy a string with size limit to safely copy src to dst.

methods.name: bbf_config_call
methods.description: Invoke a ubus method call within the given context and handle the response via callback.

methods.name: reload_specified_services
methods.description: Reloads or applies configuration to a specified list of services, with options for commit and reload.

methods.name: reload_all_services
methods.description: Reloads or applies configuration to all services within the configuration directories, with options for commit and reload.

methods.name: uci_apply_changes
methods.description: Apply UCI configuration changes in the specified configuration and save directories.

methods.name: uci_config_changes
methods.description: Generate the current UCI configuration changes into a blob buffer.
